title: Salt Mango Passion Nicotine Salt E-Liquid
description: Salt’s Mango Passion is a delicious blend of sweet, sunny Mango with the subtle tang of Passionfruit that tastes every bit like a Caribbean getaway. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices . Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
